title: Introduce SLO Tenor and Sticky Restore Conductor for safer regional restores
author: Ava Martinez
description: Context: Recent incidents showed oscillating regional restores where immediate reopen of circuits and aggressive rejoin caused repeat SLO violations. This PR introduces a new SLO Tenor concept (time-based soft window) plus a Sticky Restore Conductor to coordinate regional restores and reduce flapping. Goals: 1) reduce restore-induced SLO spikes by introducing a configurable tenor window that delays aggressive reconnection and reheats KV-preserve policies; 2) provide a sticky restore conductor that centralizes decisioning for per-region restores, with telemetry hooks for post-restore analysis; 3) add a deferred probe hedging mechanism to avoid simultaneous heavy probe storms during restores; 4) safe rollout with feature flag, metrics, and rollback path. Changeset summary: high-level design + implementation and tests. Checklist: [x] design doc (ENG-4821) updated; [x] unit + integration tests added; [x] telemetry + dashboards added; [x] feature-flagged behind slo_tenor.enable; [x] rollout plan and rollback notes included. How it works: SLO Tenor: a tunable duration attached to region-level restores that enforces a soft backoff before allowing full traffic rejoin; the conductor keeps a per-region state (sticky) that remembers last-restore epoch and prevents reopens within tenor unless explicit override; deferred probe hedge: when a restore is started, short randomized probe delays and gentle probe pacing are applied to avoid synchronized load on warm caches. Rollout plan: canary in us-east-1 with slo_tenor.enable=true and default tenor=60s; monitor 95/99 latency and token cost; after 72h expand across regions. Rollback: slo_tenor.enable=false or set tenor=0. Related: ties into SRE runbooks for regional failovers (SUP-9821).

feat(conductor): implement Sticky Restore Conductor and state machine

review_comments: Liam Chen: Nice behavioral model — can we make tenor unit configurable per-tenant later? It looks per-region only right now.
Ava Martinez: Good point — added a TODO and a small interface to allow tenant-scoped override; scoped it out for follow-up (ENG-4902).
Priya Kapoor: The conductor introduces a single-coordinator assumption; what about HA? If the conductor restarts do we rehydrate state consistently from the store?
Ava Martinez: The conductor persists a minimal epoch/state to our region metadata store with an idempotent reconcile loop; added integration to metadata sync; noted HA considerations in comments.
Marcus Green: CI flakes seen on integration test in us-west. Re-ran and all green — please sanity-check probe jitter distribution, I saw a clump at 12ms rather than intended 10-50ms.
Ava Martinez: Adjusted jitter sampler to exponential backoff distribution; tests updated to assert distribution quantiles.
Liam Chen: Please add release notes entry for the hotfix and make sure telemetry keys are in the contract for dashboards.
Ava Martinez: Added release notes and telemetry event schema (slo.tenor.restore.start|end|abort) and notified Observability team.
release_notes: Hotfix: add SLO Tenor soft-window and Sticky Restore Conductor to mitigate restore-induced SLO regressions. Feature-flagged rollout; default tenor=60s. Telemetry events: slo.tenor.restore.start/end/abort.
testing_notes: Unit and integration tests added. Local harness simulates regional restore cycles with KV warm/cold transitions. Canaryed in us-east-1 for 24h then extended to 72h; validated 95p latency reduction vs baseline in restore windows. Observability team verified dashboards and alerts.
